standing:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one high-fidelity game-character pose reference for later layered animation in Aseprite.
Input images: Image 1 is Kaida's current idle sprite, the primary identity/proportion/costume reference. Image 2 is her original larger character illustration, supporting fine-detail reference; use its right-facing view. Ignore its painted checkerboard.
Create ONE full-body Kaida in a neutral, open standing setup pose for a right-facing run. Preserve her recognizable face, short tousled magenta hair, slim athletic adult proportions, cropped teal jacket, dark bustier, exposed waist, asymmetric engraved steel shoulder armor and bracers, brown belts/pouch/thigh straps, dark fitted trousers, steel knee plates and greaves, heavy boots, two teal/magenta coat tails, and exactly the same magenta sword.
Keep the detailed painted sprite finish of the idle: fine material shading, clear dark edges, metal engravings, fabric folds, attractive refined face. Do not simplify her into chunky low-resolution pixel art or change her costume.
Camera: fixed, nearly side-on facing screen RIGHT, with a small three-quarter reveal to retain her face and armor. Both knees and boot toes point right, suitable for forward running.
Pose: upright and relaxed, one foot slightly forward and one behind so both full legs and boots are readable; separate the arms visibly from the torso. Near sword arm reaches gently backward, holding the sword trailing diagonally down-left into clear empty space, entirely clear of both legs. Far free arm is slightly forward with a softly bent elbow. Show the complete shoulder/elbow/wrist and hip/knee/ankle connections. Keep the coat tails separated from the legs wherever practical. This should look like a natural assembled person in a useful setup pose, not an exploded parts diagram.
Composition: single centered complete character; all hair, boots and sword visible with generous padding. Transparent background with actual alpha, no ground/shadow, no checkerboard, no scenery, no text or labels, no extra characters, no panels or repeated poses, no floating scraps or white edge halos.
